incidents.name: unverified_6f7a
incidents.notes: Proxy selector 0xbfd479c4 processed arbitrary token amounts with no caller authorization or ownership check, letting anyone route the victim's live balances into a liquidity path.

sources.ref: delegatecall-target review (callTracer + prestateTracer on the exploit tx, then eth_getStorageAt over [creation block, incident block]): the victim is an EIP173ProxyWithReceive, which stores its implementation in the EIP-1967 slot but announces changes with ProxyImplementationUpdated rather than Upgraded, so the standard event scan finds nothing. The exploit tx DELEGATECALLs 0x6f7a14bd...ea68 -> 0x338ffeaccf929c88fb9574dc202dc1714b1903e7 (selector 0xbfd479c4). eth_getStorageAt on slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc held 0x078a27f9de51359764ad48e663e8d8debd26656c at the creation block 13806773 and was rewritten once, at block 13844065 / 2021-12-20T19:49:44Z, to the implementation that was live at the incident (constant across 60 samples afterwards). Age 1340.6 days rather than 1346.4 from deployment
